phase: Exploratory V4 screen, design frozen before V4 build or measurements

candidates.one_far: Historical own-function profile, max1 site/function, minimum64IR lead; early decaying window
candidates.ungated: Same own-function and placement limits; remove all clock/gate/runtime overhead, no age control
candidates.callees: Profile allowlist from known main-image definitions, any eligible caller, max1site/24IR lead, RIP-relative named targets; every final linked target verified beforeIT0 patch

controls: Fresh original baseline plus own exact-layout NOP for every candidate; ungated pair has no kernel hook
orders: Exact reverse in block1, independent seeds from V3
selection: Whole CPU and mean point gains vs both controls, p99 point regression <=2%; if none qualifies, choose best cost tradeoff only for diagnostic confirmation and do not label it a winner
limitation: V4 gated policies change placement and age window together; their E2E result does not separately identify the effect of moving the window.
additional_control: base_clock: original uninstrumented executables with scheduler-clock module enabled; isolates hook cost from compiler/runtime overhead
pmu_note: Primary and late selectors in separate serial post-ROI windows; late includes walk-active cycles. FE_LATE_SWPF is demand misses with IT0/IT1 inflight, not all hint issues.
static_revision: Before any V4 timing; based on static addressing audit only.
